name: AGENT_PROXY_AUTH_TOKEN
what: Supplies the credential for the agent proxy. The client reads it once at proxy setup together with AGENT_PROXY_URL and then removes it from the environment.

name: AGENT_PROXY_URL
what: Sets the URL of the agent proxy used for outbound traffic in remote sessions. The client reads it once at proxy setup and then removes it from the environment.

name: AI_AGENT
what: Identifies the agent harness running the process. The client sets it to its own identifier at startup when it is unset or already names Claude Code.

name: ALACRITTY_LOG
what: Its presence marks the terminal as Alacritty for terminal detection and capability checks.

name: ALLOW_ANT_COMPUTER_USE_MCP
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: ALLUSERSPROFILE
what: Gives the Windows all-users profile folder. The client falls back to it to locate the Start Menu folder.

name: ALL_PROXY
what: Sets the proxy URL used when HTTPS_PROXY is unset, also under the spelling all_proxy. The client also passes it to git as its proxy for authenticated remote operations.

name: ANDROID_HOME
what: Gives the location of the Android SDK. Its presence is recorded as an installed toolchain in the environment summary.

name: ANDROID_SDK_ROOT
what: Gives the location of the Android SDK when ANDROID_HOME is unset. It is recorded as an installed toolchain.

name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
what: Sets the API key sent as the X-Api-Key header and used as the session's credential when no other key source applies.

name: ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN
what: Sets the token sent as a Bearer Authorization header on API requests.

name: ANTHROPIC_AWS_API_KEY
what: Sets the API key for Claude Platform on AWS. While it is set, the AWS credential chain is not used for that provider.

name: ANTHROPIC_AWS_BASE_URL
what: Overrides the API endpoint for Claude Platform on AWS.

name: ANTHROPIC_AWS_WORKSPACE_ID
what: Sets the workspace identifier for Claude Platform on AWS. While it is set, the anthropic-workspace-id header value is passed as the client's workspace.

name: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL
what: Overrides the Anthropic API base URL. A non-Anthropic host switches the client from first-party to gateway behaviour in several places.

name: ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_BASE_URL
what: Overrides the Amazon Bedrock endpoint.

name: ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_MANTLE_BASE_URL
what: Overrides the Bedrock Mantle endpoint.

name: ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX
what: Sets the Bedrock inference-profile region prefix instead of deriving it from the AWS region.

name: ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_SERVICE_TIER
what: Sends its value as the X-Amzn-Bedrock-Service-Tier header on Bedrock requests.

name: ANTHROPIC_BETAS
what: Adds extra API beta headers to requests as a comma-separated list, unless experimental betas are disabled by policy.

name: ANTHROPIC_CONFIG_DIR
what: Sets the directory searched for Anthropic profile configuration files.

name: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS
what: Adds extra HTTP headers to API requests, one per line, each a name and a value separated by a colon.

name: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION
what: Adds a custom model id as an extra entry in the model picker.

name: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION_DESCRIPTION
what: Sets the description shown for the custom model picker entry.

name: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION_NAME
what: Sets the label shown for the custom model picker entry.

name: ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_MODEL_OPTION_SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES
what: Overrides the built-in capability lookup for the custom model option with a comma-separated list of the capabilities it supports.

name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL
what: Sets the model id used for the Fable tier alias.

name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL_DESCRIPTION
what: Sets the description shown in the model picker for the Fable tier when its model is overridden.

name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL_NAME
what: Sets the label shown in the model picker for the Fable tier when its model is overridden.

name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_FABLE_MODEL_SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES
what: Overrides the built-in capability lookup for the overridden Fable model with a comma-separated list of the capabilities it supports.

name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL
what: Sets the model id used for the Haiku tier alias.

name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_DESCRIPTION
what: Sets the description shown in the model picker for the Haiku tier when its model is overridden.

name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_NAME
what: Sets the label shown in the model picker for the Haiku tier when its model is overridden.

name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_HAIKU_MODEL_SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES
what: Overrides the built-in capability lookup for the overridden Haiku model with a comma-separated list of the capabilities it supports.

name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL
what: Sets the default model for new sessions when no other setting picks one. The values "default" and "inherit" are ignored.

name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL
what: Sets the model id used for the Opus tier alias.

name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_DESCRIPTION
what: Sets the description shown in the model picker for the Opus tier when its model is overridden.

name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_NAME
what: Sets the label shown in the model picker for the Opus tier when its model is overridden.

name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_OPUS_MODEL_SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES
what: Overrides the built-in capability lookup for the overridden Opus model with a comma-separated list of the capabilities it supports.

name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL
what: Sets the model id used for the Sonnet tier alias.

name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_DESCRIPTION
what: Sets the description shown in the model picker for the Sonnet tier when its model is overridden.

name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_NAME
what: Sets the label shown in the model picker for the Sonnet tier when its model is overridden.

name: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL_SUPPORTED_CAPABILITIES
what: Overrides the built-in capability lookup for the overridden Sonnet model with a comma-separated list of the capabilities it supports.

name: ANTHROPIC_FEDERATION_RULE_ID
what: Sets the federation rule id used with workload identity federation credentials.

name: ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_API_KEY
what: Sets the API key for Microsoft Foundry. When it is unset, the client falls back to Azure credentials.

name: ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_AUTH_TOKEN
what: Sets the bearer token for Microsoft Foundry, used before the API key or Azure credentials.

name: ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_BASE_URL
what: Overrides the Microsoft Foundry endpoint.

name: ANTHROPIC_FOUNDRY_RESOURCE
what: Sets the Foundry resource name from which the endpoint https://<resource>.services.ai.azure.com is built.

name: ANTHROPIC_GOOGLE_CLOUD_BASE_URL
what: Overrides the endpoint for Claude on Google Cloud.

name: ANTHROPIC_GOOGLE_CLOUD_LOCATION
what: Sets the region for Claude on Google Cloud. The region is reported in the provider settings summary.

name: ANTHROPIC_GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
what: Sets the Google Cloud project id used for Claude on Google Cloud authentication when no other project variable is set.

name: ANTHROPIC_GOOGLE_CLOUD_WORKSPACE_ID
what: Sets the workspace id for Claude on Google Cloud. The id is reported in the provider settings summary.

name: ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN
what: Sets the identity token used for workload identity federation when no token file is configured.

name: ANTHROPIC_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE
what: Sets the path of the identity token file used for workload identity federation.

name: ANTHROPIC_LOG
what: Sets the log level of the bundled Anthropic SDK client logger.

name: ANTHROPIC_MODEL
what: Sets the model for the session when no model is set explicitly, with the model in settings as the fallback.

name: ANTHROPIC_ORGANIZATION_ID
what: Sets the organization id used with workload identity federation credentials.

name: ANTHROPIC_PROFILE
what: Sets the name of the Anthropic profile to use from the profile configuration directory.

name: ANTHROPIC_SCOPE
what: Sets the OAuth scope requested with workload identity federation credentials.

name: ANTHROPIC_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_ID
what: Sets the service account id used with workload identity federation credentials.

name: ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL
what: Sets the model used for small background tasks instead of the default Haiku-class model.

name: ANTHROPIC_SMALL_FAST_MODEL_AWS_REGION
what: Sets the AWS region used for requests to the small background model on Bedrock when it differs from the main region.

name: ANTHROPIC_UNIX_SOCKET
what: Sets the path of a Unix socket over which API requests are sent instead of TCP.

name: ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_BASE_URL
what: Overrides the Google Vertex AI endpoint.

name: ANTHROPIC_VERTEX_PROJECT_ID
what: Sets the Google Cloud project id for Vertex AI, used when GCLOUD_PROJECT and GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT are unset.

name: ANTHROPIC_WORKSPACE_ID
what: Sets the workspace id used with workload identity federation credentials.

name: ANT_CLAUDE_CODE_METRICS_ENDPOINT
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: ANT_OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: ANT_OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: ANT_OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: ANT_OTEL_LOGS_EXPORTER
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: ANT_OTEL_METRICS_EXPORTER
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: ANT_OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: ANT_OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: API_FORCE_IDLE_TIMEOUT
what: Controls whether the HTTP client keeps its own idle timeout on API requests when a body watchdog is active.

name: API_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for API requests in milliseconds (default 600000).

name: APPDATA
what: Gives the Windows roaming application data folder. The client uses it to locate per-user install paths such as the Chrome native host.

name: APP_URL
what: A value containing ondigitalocean.app marks the deployment environment as DigitalOcean App Platform in telemetry.

name: AUTOMODE_DECISION_LOG
what: When 1, auto-mode classifier decisions are appended to .automode_decisions.jsonl in the config directory.

name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
what: Sets the AWS access key id used for Bedrock and other AWS-backed providers.

name: AWS_ACCOUNT_ID
what: Sets the AWS account id attached to credentials read from the environment by the bundled AWS SDK.

name: AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK
what: Sets the bearer token for Amazon Bedrock. While it is set, the AWS credential chain is not used.

name: AWS_CA_BUNDLE
what: Sets the CA bundle path for AWS tools. When the client supplies its own CA bundle and this is unset, it sets it in sandboxed subprocess environments.

name: AWS_CONFIG_FILE
what: Sets the path of the AWS shared config file used to resolve region and credentials.

name: AWS_CONTAINER_AUTHORIZATION_TOKEN
what: Sets the authorization header value the bundled AWS SDK sends to the container credentials endpoint.

name: AWS_CONTAINER_AUTHORIZATION_TOKEN_FILE
what: Sets the file holding the authorization token the bundled AWS SDK sends to the container credentials endpoint.

name: AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_FULL_URI
what: Sets the full URI of the container credentials endpoint used by the AWS credential chain.

name: AWS_CONTAINER_CREDENTIALS_RELATIVE_URI
what: Sets the relative URI of the ECS container credentials endpoint used by the AWS credential chain.

name: AWS_CREDENTIAL_EXPIRATION
what: Sets the expiry time of AWS credentials read from the environment by the bundled AWS SDK.

name: AWS_CREDENTIAL_SCOPE
what: Sets the credential scope attached to AWS credentials read from the environment by the bundled AWS SDK.

name: AWS_DEFAULT_REGION
what: Sets the AWS region used when AWS_REGION is unset (default us-east-1).

name: AWS_EC2_METADATA_DISABLED
what: When set to anything other than false, the bundled AWS SDK does not query the EC2 instance metadata service.

name: AWS_ENDPOINT_URL
what: Sets the endpoint used for AWS STS calls when AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_STS is unset.

name: AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK
what: Names the Bedrock endpoint for the client's provider check. A value that points outside Bedrock's own hosts, or is not a URL, is flagged there.

name: AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_BEDROCK_RUNTIME
what: Names the Bedrock runtime endpoint for the client's provider check. A value that points outside Bedrock's own hosts, or is not a URL, is flagged there.

name: AWS_ENDPOINT_URL_STS
what: Overrides the AWS STS endpoint.

name: AWS_EXECUTION_ENV
what: Holds the AWS runtime marker that the client uses to detect Fargate or ECS as the deployment environment.

name: AWS_LAMBDA_BENCHMARK_MODE
what: When 1, the bundled AWS Lambda helper exposes a test reset hook.

name: AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME
what: Its presence marks the deployment environment as AWS Lambda.

name: AWS_LAMBDA_NODEJS_NO_GLOBAL_AWSLAMBDA
what: When true or 1, the bundled AWS Lambda helper does not create the global awslambda object.

name: AWS_LOGIN_CACHE_DIRECTORY
what: Sets the directory where the bundled AWS SDK caches login session tokens (default ~/.aws/login/cache).

name: AWS_PROFILE
what: Sets the AWS profile used to resolve credentials and region.

name: AWS_REGION
what: Sets the AWS region for Bedrock and other AWS-backed providers.

name: AWS_ROLE_ARN
what: Sets the IAM role assumed with a web identity token by the AWS credential chain.

name: AWS_ROLE_SESSION_NAME
what: Sets the session name used when the bundled AWS SDK assumes a role with a web identity token.

name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
what: Sets the AWS secret access key paired with AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.

name: AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
what: Sets the AWS session token paired with the access key pair.

name: AWS_SHARED_CREDENTIALS_FILE
what: Sets the path of the AWS shared credentials file.

name: AWS_USE_FIPS_ENDPOINT
what: When true, AWS STS calls go to the FIPS endpoint.

name: AWS_WEB_IDENTITY_TOKEN_FILE
what: Sets the path of the web identity token the AWS credential chain exchanges for role credentials.

name: AZURE_ADDITIONALLY_ALLOWED_TENANTS
what: Sets the extra Azure tenants, separated by semicolons, that the bundled Azure identity library may request tokens for.

name: AZURE_AUTHORITY_HOST
what: Sets the Azure authority host used by the bundled Azure identity library.

name: AZURE_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_PASSWORD
what: Sets the password of the Azure client certificate used for Foundry authentication through the Azure identity library.

name: AZURE_CLIENT_CERTIFICATE_PATH
what: Sets the path of the Azure client certificate used for Foundry authentication through the Azure identity library.

name: AZURE_CLIENT_ID
what: Sets the Azure application client id used by the Azure identity library for Foundry authentication.

name: AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET
what: Sets the Azure client secret used by the Azure identity library for Foundry authentication.

name: AZURE_CLIENT_SEND_CERTIFICATE_CHAIN
what: When true or 1, the Azure identity library sends the certificate chain with certificate authentication.

name: AZURE_FEDERATED_TOKEN_FILE
what: Sets the path of the federated token file for Azure workload identity.

name: AZURE_FUNCTIONS_ENVIRONMENT
what: Its presence marks the deployment environment as Azure Functions.

name: AZURE_IDENTITY_DISABLE_MULTITENANTAUTH
what: When set, the Azure identity library always uses the configured tenant instead of a request's tenant.

name: AZURE_LOG_LEVEL
what: Sets the log level of the bundled Azure SDK logger.

name: AZURE_PASSWORD
what: Sets the password for Azure username and password authentication in the Azure identity library.

name: AZURE_POD_IDENTITY_AUTHORITY_HOST
what: Sets the endpoint of the Azure pod identity service used for managed identity tokens.

name: AZURE_REGIONAL_AUTHORITY_NAME
what: Sets the Azure region used for regional token authority by the Azure identity library.

name: AZURE_TENANT_ID
what: Sets the Azure tenant id used by the Azure identity library for Foundry authentication.

name: AZURE_TOKEN_CREDENTIALS
what: Selects which credential group (dev or prod) the Azure default credential chain tries.

name: AZURE_USERNAME
what: Sets the username for Azure username and password authentication in the Azure identity library.

name: BASH_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the default timeout for Bash commands in milliseconds (default 120000).

name: BASH_MAX_OUTPUT_LENGTH
what: Sets the maximum characters of Bash tool output kept before truncation, when the bashOutputMaxChars setting is unset.

name: BASH_MAX_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the longest timeout a Bash command may request, in milliseconds (default 600000, never below the default timeout).

name: BAT_THEME
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: BETA_TRACING_ENDPOINT
what: Sets the endpoint for detailed beta tracing. That tracing is on only when ENABLE_BETA_TRACING_DETAILED is also set.

name: BROWSER
what: Names the preferred browser command. It is recorded in the terminal capability report and restored after the client changes it for a moment.

name: BUF_BIGINT_DISABLE
what: When 1, the bundled protobuf library does not use BigInt for 64-bit integers.

name: BUGHUNTER_DEV_BUNDLE_B64
what: Supplies a development bundle that is forwarded to the remote bug-hunter job.

name: BUGHUNTER_FLEET_SIZE
what: By its name, it sets the size of a bug-hunter fleet. In a remote session, setting it fails a check that otherwise passes for some entrypoints.

name: BUILDKITE
what: Its presence marks the environment as Buildkite CI.

name: BUN_CHROME_PATH
what: Sets the path of the Chrome binary used for artifact previews, replacing the automatic search.

name: BUN_INSTALL
what: Gives the Bun install root. The client uses it to recognise a global Bun installation of Claude Code.

name: C9_PID
what: Its presence marks the environment as AWS Cloud9.

name: C9_USER
what: Its presence marks the environment as AWS Cloud9.

name: CARGO_HTTP_CAINFO
what: Sets the CA bundle path for Cargo. When the client supplies its own CA bundle, it sets this in sandboxed subprocess environments.

name: CCR_AGENT_PROXY_CA_CERT_B64
what: Supplies the CA certificate of the remote-session agent proxy. The client reads it once at proxy setup and then removes it from the environment.

name: CCR_AGENT_PROXY_ENABLED
what: Turns on the agent proxy in a remote session.

name: CCR_AGENT_PROXY_FRAME_HOSTS
what: Lists the hosts whose traffic the remote-session agent proxy frames.

name: CCR_AGENT_PROXY_INCLUDE_HOSTS
what: Lists the hosts routed through the remote-session agent proxy. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CCR_AGENT_PROXY_NO_PROXY_LOCAL_ONLY
what: Restricts the remote-session agent proxy's no-proxy list to local addresses. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CCR_AGENT_PROXY_RECEIVE_GATE_DISABLED
what: Disables the receive gate of the remote-session agent proxy. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CCR_AGENT_PROXY_RELAY_MODE
what: Sets the relay mode of the remote-session agent proxy. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CCR_AGENT_PROXY_UPLOAD_GATE_DISABLED
what: Disables the upload gate of the remote-session agent proxy. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CCR_DELTA_RESET
inert: The client reads it only through a registry built over an empty shape. Every read there returns undefined and never sees the value set in the environment.

name: CCR_ENABLE_BUNDLE
what: Forces repository bundle seeding on for remote sessions, bypassing the server-side gate.

name: CCR_FORCE_BUNDLE
what: Forces repository bundle seeding on for remote sessions, bypassing the server-side gate.

name: CCR_ON_BRANCH_DEFAULT_GUARD
what: Sets the mode of the guard against working on a repository's default branch in remote sessions (enforce, observe or off).

name: CCR_PREFETCH_NETWORK
inert: The client reads it only through a registry built over an empty shape. Every read there returns undefined and never sees the value set in the environment.

name: CCR_PREWARM_STAT
inert: The client reads it only through a registry built over an empty shape. Every read there returns undefined and never sees the value set in the environment.

name: CCR_PREWARM_VDA
inert: The client reads it only through a registry built over an empty shape. Every read there returns undefined and never sees the value set in the environment.

name: CCR_RUNNER_STARTUP_TIMING
inert: The client reads it only through a registry built over an empty shape. Every read there returns undefined and never sees the value set in the environment.

name: CCR_SESSION_PROFILE
what: When set, inline tools are turned off for a remote session profile.

name: CCR_SHR_SSE_HINTS
what: Turns on server-sent-event hints for the self-hosted runner.

name: CCR_SPAWN_TIMESTAMP_MS
what: Holds the spawn time of a remote session process, which the client uses to measure startup latency.

name: CDPATH
what: While it is set for the shells the client starts, a cd to a bare relative directory loses a shortcut in the Bash permission check. The client also clears it in its own cd commands.

name: CF_PAGES
what: When truthy, marks the deployment environment as Cloudflare Pages.

name: CHOKIDAR_INTERVAL
what: Sets the polling interval of the bundled file watcher.

name: CHOKIDAR_USEPOLLING
what: Forces the bundled file watcher to poll (true or 1) or not to poll (false or 0).

name: CI
what: When set, the bundled hyperlink-support check treats the terminal as not supporting hyperlinks.

name: CIRCLECI
what: Its presence marks the environment as CircleCI.

name: CLAUBBIT
what: Marks the process as running under Anthropic's internal Claubbit harness. The mark is recorded in telemetry and alters some behaviour.

name: CLAUDECODE
what: Claude Code sets this in the shells it starts. Its presence tells a nested process that it runs inside Claude Code.

name: CLAUDE_AFK_COUNTDOWN_MS
what: Sets how long before the away timeout the countdown is shown, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_AFK_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the away timeout in milliseconds after which the idle prompt acts on its own.

name: CLAUDE_AFTER_LAST_COMPACT
what: When truthy, transcript fetches for a remote session request only the messages after the last compaction.

name: CLAUDE_AGENTS_AUTO_RELAUNCHED_AT
what: Holds the time of the agents view's last automatic relaunch. The view uses it to avoid relaunching again too soon.

name: CLAUDE_AGENTS_SELECT
what: Carries a handoff value set before the agents view relaunches the client. Its presence selects that view on start.

name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_CLIENT_APP
what: Sets the client application name added to the User-Agent as client-app/<value>.

name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_DISABLE_BUILTIN_AGENTS
what: In SDK sessions, turns off the built-in subagent types.

name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_DISABLE_MCP_MANIFESTS
what: Stops the SDK from capturing MCP server manifests.

name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_MCP_NO_PREFIX
what: Keeps the bare names of tools from SDK-provided MCP servers, without the mcp__ prefix.

name: CLAUDE_AGENT_SDK_VERSION
what: Gives the version of the Agent SDK hosting the client, which the SDK sets when it spawns the client. The client adds it to the User-Agent.

name: CLAUDE_ARTIFACT_HOST_GRANT
what: Sets the host grant used when publishing artifacts, naming which host servers an artifact may use.

name: CLAUDE_ASYNC_AGENT_STALL_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the stall timeout for background agents in milliseconds, replacing the timeout derived from the stream watchdog.

name: CLAUDE_AUTOCOMPACT_PCT_OVERRIDE
what: Sets the percentage of the context window at which automatic compaction triggers, replacing the built-in threshold.

name: CLAUDE_AUTO_BACKGROUND_TASKS
what: Turns on scheduled worker check-ins for background tasks outside coordinator mode.

name: CLAUDE_AX_PREPARK_MS
what: Sets the screen-reader mode pre-park delay in milliseconds (capped at 5000).

name: CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER
what: Turns screen-reader support on or off, with the --ax-screen-reader flag taking precedence and the axScreenReader setting used when it is unset.

name: CLAUDE_AX_STARTUP_QUIET_MS
what: Sets the length of the screen-reader quiet period after startup in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_BASH_MAINTAIN_PROJECT_WORKING_DIR
what: When truthy, the Bash tool returns to the project directory after each command.

name: CLAUDE_BG_AUTH_SNAPSHOT_PATH
what: Gives the path of an authentication snapshot that a background session's launcher hands over. The session consumes and removes it at startup.

name: CLAUDE_BG_AUTO_MEMORY_OFF
what: A background session's launcher sets this handoff flag, part of the background-session environment, to say auto memory was off.

name: CLAUDE_BG_BACKEND
what: Names the backend hosting a background session. The value "daemon" marks a daemon-hosted session.

name: CLAUDE_BG_CLAIM_AUTH
what: Hands a claim credential to a pre-started spare background session. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CLAUDE_BG_DISPATCHER_RATE_LIMIT_TIER
what: Carries the rate-limit tier of the dispatcher that launched a background session, for that session's reports.

name: CLAUDE_BG_DISPATCHER_SUBSCRIPTION_TYPE
what: Carries the subscription type of the dispatcher that launched a background session, for that session's reports.

name: CLAUDE_BG_ISOLATION
what: Sets the isolation mode of a background session, "worktree" or "none", as its launcher passes it. Without it, the worktree.bgIsolation setting decides.

name: CLAUDE_BG_MEMORY_TOGGLED_OFF
what: When 1 in a background session, auto memory starts switched off, carrying over the launcher's toggle.

name: CLAUDE_BG_POST_CLEAR_RESPAWN
what: Marks a background session respawned after /clear. Start-up then treats it as a fresh conversation instead of a resume.

name: CLAUDE_BG_PTY_AUTH
what: Supplies the credential for the background session's terminal host. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CLAUDE_BG_RENDEZVOUS_SOCK
what: Names the socket a background session uses to meet its launcher. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CLAUDE_BG_RV_AUTH
what: Supplies the credential for the background-session rendezvous socket. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CLAUDE_BG_SESSION_PERMISSION_RULES
what: Hands a background session the JSON allow and deny permission rules from its launcher.

name: CLAUDE_BG_SOCKET_TOKENS_PATH
what: Gives the path of a file holding background-session socket credentials. The client reads it once and then removes it from the environment.

name: CLAUDE_BG_SOURCE
what: Says how a background session was started. The value "spare" marks a pre-started spare process.

name: CLAUDE_BG_STARTUP_WEDGE_MS
what: Sets the time after which a background session that has not finished starting is treated as wedged (default 45000 ms).

name: CLAUDE_BG_TCC_DISCLAIMED
what: The client sets this before it re-executes itself on macOS to disclaim privacy-permission ownership. On the second start it is removed and the step is skipped.

name: CLAUDE_BG_WORKSPACE_TRUSTED

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ALTERNATE_SCREEN
what: Keeps the terminal UI out of the alternate screen buffer.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ARTIFACT
what: Turns off the Artifact tool and is checked before the enableArtifact and disableArtifact settings.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ATTACHMENTS
what: Turns off attachments, including deferred tool attachments.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ATTRIBUTION_BASELINE_REUSE
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ATTRIBUTION_CROSS_REPO
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTH_REFRESH_LOCK
what: Turns off the file lock that serialises credential refreshes across processes.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AUTO_MEMORY
what: A truthy value turns auto memory off and a falsy value forces it on.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_AWAITING_USER_IDLE
what: Stops the session from reporting itself idle while it waits on the user.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BACKGROUND_TASKS
what: Turns off background tasks.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BEDROCK_CONTENT_TYPE_DEFAULT
what: Stops the client from adding the event-stream content type to Bedrock responses that lack one.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BEDROCK_CONTENT_TYPE_GUARD
what: Stops the client from rejecting Bedrock streaming responses with an unexpected content type.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_EXIT_HANDOFF
what: Turns off handing running work to a background session when the client exits.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BG_SHELL_PRESSURE_REAP
what: Turns off killing background shells under resource pressure.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_BUNDLED_SKILLS
what: Turns off the skills bundled with Claude Code.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CFC_PROMPT
what: Removes the Chrome integration's system prompt.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_API_SKILL
what: Turns off the bundled Claude API skill.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_CODE_SKILL
what: Turns off the bundled Claude Code skill.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CLAUDE_MDS
what: Stops CLAUDE.md files from loading. The client sets it itself in safe mode.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON
what: Turns off the cron scheduling tools.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_DANGEROUS_RM_TIMEOUT
what: Turns off the timeout on dangerous rm confirmations.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS
what: Stops the client from sending experimental API beta headers.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPLORE_INHERIT_CAP
what: Lets the built-in Explore agent inherit the session model without the Opus cap.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPLORE_PLAN_AGENTS
what: Turns off the built-in Explore and Plan agents.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FAST_MODE
what: Turns off fast mode.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY
what: Turns off feedback surveys.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_FILE_CHECKPOINTING
what: Turns off file checkpointing.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_GIT_INSTRUCTIONS
what: Removes the built-in git instructions from the system prompt. When it is unset, the includeGitInstructions setting decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_HOOK_FORWARDING
what: Serves as the off switch of the check that admits forwarded hooks over the SDK connection. Going by the name, it stops hook forwarding to remote sessions.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LAUNCH_COMPOSER
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_LEGACY_MODEL_REMAP
what: Stops the client from remapping legacy model ids to current ones.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MCP_TASK_BACKGROUND
what: Stops MCP tasks from moving to the background.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MEMORY_BULK_INFLATE
what: Turns off bulk download of the memory store.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MEMORY_MASS_DELETE_HOLD
what: Turns off the safety hold on mass deletions in the memory store.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MEMORY_PERIODIC_RESYNC
what: Turns off periodic resync of the memory store.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MEMORY_RO_UNSAVED_NOTICE
what: Turns off the notice about unsaved changes in a read-only memory store.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MEMORY_STREAM_LIST
what: Turns off streamed listing of the memory store.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MODEL_ACCESS_FALLBACK
what: Turns off falling back to another model when the configured one is not available to the account.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE
what: A truthy value turns mouse support off and a falsy value forces full mouse support.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MOUSE_CLICKS
what: A truthy value keeps scrolling but turns off mouse clicks.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_MTLS_RELOAD_ON_STALE_CONNECTION
what: Stops the client from reloading the mutual TLS certificate after a stale connection.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_CHAIN_IDLE
what: When set, a blocked nested prompt chain is not counted toward the session waiting on the user. The name suggests this keeps such chains from idling the session.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NESTED_USER_REPAIR
what: Turns off repairing malformed nested user messages from SDK input.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC
what: Turns off non-essential network traffic, including telemetry and feature-flag fetching.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONSTREAMING_FALLBACK
what: Turns off retrying a failed streaming request as a non-streaming one.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NOTIFICATION_PRESENCE_CHECK
what: Sends notifications even when the user appears to be present.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_OFFICIAL_MARKETPLACE_AUTOINSTALL
what: Turns off automatic installation of the official plugin marketplace.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ORG_MEMORY
what: Turns off organization memory.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_PERMISSION_PROMPT_NOTIFY_HOOKS
what: Turns off the notification hooks fired when a permission prompt waits.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_PLUGIN_FORWARDING
what: Turns off forwarding this machine's plugins to cloud sessions.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_POLICY_SKILLS
what: Skips skills from managed policy settings.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_POWERSHELL_CMD_RM_DENY
what: Turns off denying cmd-style recursive deletes in PowerShell.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_PRECOMPACT_SKIP
what: By its name, it turns off a step that skips work before compaction. The client parses it while loading a session's stored entries.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_FALLBACK
what: Turns off switching to a fallback model after a refusal.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_REFUSAL_RETRY
what: Turns off retrying after a refusal.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_STARTUP_WORK_GATE
what: Stops the client from arming its startup work gate. Going by the name and the hold and release calls beside it, that gate defers work until startup finishes.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_SUBSTITUTION_RM_PROMPT
what: Turns off the prompt for rm commands whose target comes from a command substitution.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TERMINAL_TITLE
what: Stops the client from setting the terminal title.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_THINKING
what: Turns off extended thinking.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_TURN_HANDOFF
what: Serves as the off switch of the check that admits turn handoff for a remote session. By the name, it stops turns passing between that session and this client.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_UNKNOWN_MODEL_WINDOW_ENFORCEMENT
what: Stops the client from enforcing the default context window for unrecognised models.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_VIRTUAL_SCROLL
what: Turns off virtual scrolling in the transcript.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_VITALS_EMITTER
what: Turns off the guest vitals emitter.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WEB_FETCH
what: Turns off the WebFetch tool.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WINDOWS_SHELL_LAUNCHER
what: Turns off the Windows shell launcher.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKFLOWS
what: Turns off workflows.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_WORKING_SYNC
what: In a remote session, turns off syncing working files.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISPATCH_V2D
inert: The client reads it only through a registry built over an empty shape. Every read there returns undefined and never sees the value set in the environment.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DISPATCH_V2S
inert: The client reads it only through a registry built over an empty shape. Every read there returns undefined and never sees the value set in the environment.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DONT_INHERIT_ENV
what: Starts the shell snapshot without the user's environment.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_DOWNLOAD_DEADLINE_MS_FOR_TESTING
what: Sets the download deadline for updates, for testing.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EAGER_FLUSH
what: Flushes the transcript to disk after every write.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EDITOR_CODELIVERY
what: With it set, a relayed human message can carry an artifact follow-up acknowledgement with an https URL. By the name, the editor then delivers that follow-up too.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EFFORT_LEVEL
what: Sets the effort level for the session. Unset and "auto" both mean no override.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ELEGANT_MEADOW
what: Forces the value of the tengu_elegant_meadow gate either way, with the gate deciding when it is unset. What that gate controls cannot be told from its name.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EMIT_SESSION_STATE_EVENTS
what: Emits session_state_changed system events on the SDK output stream.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EMIT_STARTUP_TIMING
what: Emits startup timing phases outside remote sessions too.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EMIT_TOOL_USE_SUMMARIES
what: Fills the emitToolUseSummaries setting of the session's query config. By the name, it makes the client emit summaries of tool use, likely on the SDK stream.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_APPEND_SUBAGENT_PROMPT
what: Lets the SDK option appendSubagentSystemPrompt add text to subagent system prompts. The SDK sets it when that option is used.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_AWAY_SUMMARY
what: Forces the away summary on (truthy) or off (falsy). Otherwise the awaySummaryEnabled setting decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_BACKGROUND_PLUGIN_REFRESH
what: Refreshes plugins in the background after startup.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_CFC
what: Turns the Claude in Chrome integration on or off by default. Flags and settings can still decide.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_DESIGN_SYNC
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_ADVISOR_TOOL
what: Forces the experimental advisor tool on where it is available. Otherwise a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FEEDBACK_SURVEY_FOR_OTEL
what: Keeps feedback surveys on when telemetry is otherwise off for OpenTelemetry users.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FINE_GRAINED_TOOL_STREAMING
what: A false value turns off fine-grained tool input streaming. Otherwise the provider and a server-side gate decide.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY
what: Discovers available models from a non-Anthropic ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL gateway.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_LAUNCH_COMPOSER
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_MENU_KIND_LANES
what: Turns on lanes in the slash-command menu, as the tengu_mint_lanes gate does when the variable is unset. By the name, the lanes group commands by kind.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROMPT_SUGGESTION
what: Turns prompt suggestions on or off.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_PROXY_AUTH_HELPER
what: Turns on the proxy authentication helper configured in settings.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_REFRESH_MCP_TOOLS
what: Adds the RefreshMcpTools tool to the tools the model can call. That tool asks connected MCP servers for their current tool lists again.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_REMOTE_RECAP
what: Turns the recap for remote sessions on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_SDK_FILE_CHECKPOINTING
what: Turns on file checkpointing in SDK sessions. The SDK sets it from its checkpointing option.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TASKS
what: A false value turns off the task tools.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY
what: Turns on OpenTelemetry export of metrics and events.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS
what: Turns on the todo tools where the default would leave them off.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TOKEN_USAGE_ATTACHMENT
what: Attaches token usage (used, total, remaining) to the model's context.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_XAA
what: Turns on cross-app access (XAA) for MCP authentication.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENHANCED_TELEMETRY_BETA
what: Turns on the enhanced telemetry beta (turn trace contexts), the same as ENABLE_ENHANCED_TELEMETRY_BETA.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENTRYPOINT
what: Names how the client was launched (cli, sdk-ts, claude-vscode, remote and others). The client sets it at startup and branches many behaviours on it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENVIRONMENT_KIND
what: Names the kind of hosting environment, such as byoc for bring-your-own-compute.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_ENVIRONMENT_RUNNER_VERSION
what: Gives the version of the environment runner, which is sent as the x-environment-runner-version header.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EVAL_ALLOW_ARTIFACT_PUBLISH
inert: The client reads it only through a registry built over an empty shape. Every read there returns undefined and never sees the value set in the environment.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EVAL_ALLOW_FLAG_OVERRIDES
inert: The client reads it only through a registry built over an empty shape. Every read there returns undefined and never sees the value set in the environment.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EVAL_ARTIFACT_STUB_DIR
inert: The client reads it only through a registry built over an empty shape. Every read there returns undefined and never sees the value set in the environment.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EVAL_CONFINED
what: Marks an evaluation child process, in which allow permission rules are dropped.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EVAL_INTERVIEW_SESSION
what: Marks an evaluation interview session, in which reports are not published. The client sets it when starting one.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXIT_AFTER_FIRST_RENDER
what: Skips the startup prefetches and the fullscreen crash check. Going by the name, the process exits after the terminal UI first renders, as for timing startup.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXIT_AFTER_STOP_DELAY
what: Exits this many milliseconds after the session stops and stays idle.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS
what: Turns on agent teams, the same as --agent-teams, though a server-side gate can still veto.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_OBSERVER_AGENTS
what: Turns on observer agents, though a server-side gate can still veto.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_BODY
what: Merges a JSON object into API request bodies without overriding system, tools or messages.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_EXTRA_METADATA
what: Adds a JSON object to request metadata.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FEDERATION_CACHE_DIR
what: Sets the directory for the workload identity federation token cache.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FILE_READ_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS
what: Sets the maximum tokens the Read tool returns from one file.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FLAG_FETCH_WAIT_MS
what: Sets how long startup waits for feature flags after a relaunch, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FLEETVIEW_SIMPLE
what: Uses the simple fleet view. Otherwise a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FLEET_PAST_SESSIONS
inert: The client reads it only through a registry built over an empty shape. Every read there returns undefined and never sees the value set in the environment.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FOOTER_INDICATOR
what: Sets the text of the footer indicator, ahead of the value from client data.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_BRIDGE
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_EVALUATE_MEMORY
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_FIRST_LAUNCH
inert: The client reads it only through a registry built over an empty shape. Every read there returns undefined and never sees the value set in the environment.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_FULLSCREEN_UPSELL
what: Forces the fullscreen-mode upsell to show.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_MEMORY_SURVEY
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_MID_CONVERSATION_SYSTEM
what: Forces mid-conversation system messages for tool changes on models that support them.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_RC_LONG_TURN_NUDGE
inert: The client reads it only through a registry built over an empty shape. Every read there returns undefined and never sees the value set in the environment.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_SESSION_PERSISTENCE
what: Overrides the check that would turn session persistence off in a child session. By the name, it keeps persistence on there.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_STRIKETHROUGH
what: Treats the terminal as supporting strikethrough text.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_SYNC_OUTPUT
what: Treats the terminal as supporting synchronized output.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_TERMINAL_IMAGES
what: Treats the terminal as supporting inline images.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_TIP_ID
what: Names, by id, the spinner tip to show when USER_TYPE marks an internal user. It works only while the tengu_tips_mod gate turns the spinner-tips plugin on.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORCE_WINDOWS_CREDMAN
what: When 1, stores credentials in the Windows Credential Manager regardless of the server-side gate.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORK_SUBAGENT
what: Turns forked subagents on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORWARD_SUBAGENT_TEXT
what: Forwards subagent text on the SDK output stream.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FORWARD_USER_INTENT
what: Going by the name and the message-attribution code beside it, it forwards the user's intent with relayed messages.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FRAME_TIMING_LOG
what: Sets the path of a file to which terminal frame timings are appended.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_FRAME_TIMING_SAMPLE_EVERY
what: Logs every Nth frame timing to the frame timing log.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_HINT_HEADERS
what: Turns gateway hint headers on or off. Otherwise the provider and a server-side gate decide.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for gateway model discovery in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GATEWAY_TOKEN_FILE_DESCRIPTOR
what: Gives a file descriptor from which a gateway token is read at startup. The client removes it from the environment after use.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GB_BASE_URL
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GB_DISK_CACHE_WHEN_TELEMETRY_OFF
what: With telemetry off, lets feature-flag reads answer from the cached values in the global config file.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GB_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GENTLE_PARASOL
what: Overrides the per-model text of an ephemeral reminder that otherwise comes from client data.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GIT_BASH_PATH
what: Sets the path of the Git Bash executable on Windows.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GLOB_HIDDEN
what: Sets whether file search includes hidden files (default true).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GLOB_NO_IGNORE
what: Sets whether file search ignores .gitignore rules (default true).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GLOB_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
what: Sets the timeout for file search in seconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES
what: Sets the interval between goal check-ins in minutes.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GORSE_PLOVER
what: Forces on the Bash act-first behaviour. Otherwise client data or a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GROWTHBOOK_KICK_FROM_INIT
what: By the name and the startup code, it starts the feature-flag fetch during initialisation. Startup telemetry records it as kick_from_init.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_CCR_REQUEST_BODIES
what: Turns gzip compression of remote-worker request bodies on or off.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODIES
what: Turns gzip compression of API request bodies on or off.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODY_BLOCKS
what: Chooses the gzip block mode for request bodies (0, 1 or 2). Otherwise a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_GZIP_REQUEST_BODY_LEVEL
what: Sets the gzip compression level for request bodies (1 to 9). Otherwise a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HANDBACK_PROVENANCE
inert: The client reads it only through a registry built over an empty shape. Every read there returns undefined and never sees the value set in the environment.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HARBOR_KITE
what: Forces harbor kite on or off, which the strings near it describe as cross-session messaging. Unset, tengu_harbor_kite decides, with tengu_harbor_kite_win able to veto it on Windows.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HARBOR_KITE_CLOUD
what: By the name, it extends harbor kite to cloud sessions, through a check that also needs remote sessions allowed. Unset, the tengu_harbor_kite_cloud gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HARBOR_KITE_PACING_OFF
what: Turns off pacing of outbound harbor kite messages.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HFI_BEARER_TOKEN
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HIDE_CWD
what: Hides the working directory in the startup header.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HIDE_SETTINGS_HINT
what: When truthy, hides the settings hint.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOLD_REPORT_PARK_AT_INIT
what: Holds the report that a resumed interrupted turn is parked until initialisation finishes.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOME_SEED_HOLD_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the maximum hold while the home directory is being seeded, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOME_SEED_VERDICT_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the maximum wait for the home seeding verdict, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOOKS_SAME_THREAD
what: Runs function hooks on the main thread instead of a worker. The client sets it itself during hook registration.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_AUTH_ENV_VAR
what: Names the environment variable that carries a host-provided auth token.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_AUTH_REFRESH_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for asking the SDK host to refresh its auth token, in milliseconds.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_CREDS_FILE
what: Gives the path of a host-provided credentials file, used together with the gateway lineage marker.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_GATEWAY_LINEAGE
what: Marks a process started by a gateway host. The client sets it for its children.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_PLATFORM
what: Overrides the detected platform (win32, darwin or linux).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_PROMPT_SUPERSEDES_RECORD
what: Read when a print-mode session starts and passed on to child processes. By the name, the host's prompt then replaces the one recorded in the session.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_SCHEDULED_RUN
what: Recorded in the client's state at startup. Going by the name, it marks a run that the host scheduled.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOST_SESSION_ID
what: In a session hosted by the desktop app, the client reads it next to its session-naming code. By the name, it carries the session id that host assigned.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HOVER_REST
what: When its value parses as "pinned", the client apparently ties its storage to the config folder named at startup. Unset, the tengu_hover_rest gate supplies the value.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HTTPS_PROXY
what: Sets the HTTPS proxy used for sandboxed commands when HTTPS_PROXY and https_proxy are unset.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HTTP_PROXY
what: Sets the HTTP proxy used for sandboxed commands when HTTP_PROXY and http_proxy are unset.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_HUMBLE_HAMMOCK
what: Forces the tengu_humble_hammock behaviour either way, with another check or the gate deciding when it is unset. Its purpose cannot be told from the name.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_HOST_OVERRIDE
what: Sets the host address used to reach the IDE, instead of 127.0.0.1 or the WSL default route.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_SKIP_AUTO_INSTALL
what: Stops automatic installation of the IDE extension.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_IDE_SKIP_VALID_CHECK
what: Skips checking that an IDE's workspace contains the working directory.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_THRESHOLD_MINUTES
what: Sets the idle minutes after which the idle-session action runs (default 75).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_IDLE_TOKEN_THRESHOLD
what: Sets the minimum context tokens before the idle-session action applies (default 100000).

name: CLAUDE_CODE_INCLUDE_PARTIAL_MESSAGES
what: Includes partial streaming messages on the SDK output stream.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_INLINE_TOOLS
what: Turns inline tools on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_INTRO_FRAME
what: Turns on or off an introductory framing in the system prompt. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_IS_COWORK
what: Marks the process, by its name, as running inside the Cowork app. Several checks then treat it as they treat a remote session, synced skills among them.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_JUNIPER_SUNDIAL
what: Sets the number of turns between maintenance passes, 10 by default. When it is unset, client data or the tengu_juniper_sundial gate supplies the number.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_KB_COHESION_FIXES
what: Turns on one check. Going by the name, that check enables a set of "KB cohesion" fixes.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_LANTERN_PRISM
what: Forces on the tengu_lantern_prism behaviour regardless of the gate. That behaviour cannot be told from the name.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_LARCH_CISTERN
what: Forces on a model-specific behaviour the client names "larch_cistern". When it is unset, the model's configuration decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_LEGACY_BUNDLE
what: Uses the previous git bundle behaviour for this session.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_KEEPALIVE
what: Turns loop keepalive on or off. When it is unset, a server-side gate decides.

name: CLAUDE_CODE_LOOP_PERSISTENT

name: SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_LOCK_TO_ACCOUNT
what: Sets the account the self-hosted runner is locked to.

name: SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_LOG_FILE
what: Sets the log file of the self-hosted runner.

name: SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_MAX_LIFETIME_GRACE_MS
what: Sets the grace period after a session's maximum lifetime on the self-hosted runner.

name: SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_MAX_LIFETIME_MS
what: Sets the maximum lifetime of a session on the self-hosted runner, in milliseconds.

name: SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_POOL_SECRET
what: Serves as the deprecated name for SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT_SECRET.

name: SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_POST_SESSION_HOOK_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the timeout for the post-session hook on the self-hosted runner, in milliseconds.

name: SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_POST_TURN_SETTLE_MS
what: Sets the settle time after a turn on the self-hosted runner, in milliseconds.

name: SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_PUSH_OUTCOME_ON_RELEASE
what: Pushes the outcome when the self-hosted runner releases a session.

name: SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_REMOVE_SESSION_STATE
what: Removes session state on the self-hosted runner.

name: SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_RETIRE_AT
what: Sets the Unix time at which the self-hosted runner retires.

name: SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_SESSION_IDLE_MS
what: Sets the session idle timeout on the self-hosted runner, in milliseconds.

name: SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_SESSION_STOP_GRACE_MS
what: Sets the grace period for stopping a session on the self-hosted runner, in milliseconds.

name: SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_SIGKILL_GRACE_MS
what: Sets the grace period before SIGKILL on the self-hosted runner, in milliseconds.

name: SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_SIGKILL_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Setting this old name for SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_SESSION_STOP_GRACE_MS is a fatal error.

name: SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_STARTUP_TIMEOUT_MS
what: Sets the startup timeout of the self-hosted runner, in milliseconds (default 900000).

name: SELF_HOSTED_RUNNER_TRUST_WORKSPACE
what: Trusts the workspace on the self-hosted runner.

name: SESSIONNAME
what: Holds the Windows session name, used with TERM to recognise Cygwin.

name: SESSION_INGRESS_URL
what: Gives the URL of the session ingress service.

name: SHELL
what: Names the user's shell. On Windows the client sets it to the Git Bash path.

name: SLASH_COMMAND_TOOL_CHAR_BUDGET
what: Sets the character budget for the skill listing in the tool description.

name: SPACE_CREATOR_USER_ID
what: Its presence marks the deployment environment as Hugging Face Spaces.

name: SRT_DEBUG
what: Prints sandbox runtime debug messages.

name: SSH_AUTH_SOCK
what: Names the SSH agent socket, whose absence affects how git access is set up behind the agent proxy.

name: SSH_CLIENT
what: Its presence marks an SSH session.

name: SSH_CONNECTION
what: Its presence marks an SSH session.

name: SSH_TTY
what: Its presence marks an SSH session.

name: SSL_CERT_DIR
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: SSL_CERT_FILE
what: Sets the CA certificate file.

name: STY
what: Its presence marks the terminal as GNU screen.

name: SUDO_GID
what: Gives the group id of the user who ran sudo, used when the client runs as root under a verified sudo.

name: SUDO_UID
what: Gives the user id of the user who ran sudo. When the client runs as root, files that user owns pass its ownership checks.

name: SUDO_USER
what: Gives the name of the user who ran sudo, used when the client runs as root under a verified sudo.

name: SWE_BENCH_INSTANCE_ID
what: Holds the SWE-bench instance id, recorded in telemetry.

name: SWE_BENCH_RUN_ID
what: Holds the SWE-bench run id, recorded in telemetry.

name: SWE_BENCH_TASK_ID
what: Holds the SWE-bench task id, recorded in telemetry.

name: SYSTEMROOT
what: Names the Windows system folder and is also read under the spelling SystemRoot.

name: SYSTEM_REMINDER_MEMORY_CONTEXT
what: With an allowed entrypoint, a truthy value turns on a memory feature that tengu_misty_anchor also gates. The name suggests it adds memory context to system reminders.

name: TEAMCITY_VERSION
what: Gives the TeamCity version. The bundled hyperlink-support check uses it to decide whether hyperlinks work.

name: TEMP
what: On Windows the client reads it first, ahead of TMP, as the folder for scratch git index files when CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR is unset. Outside Windows and macOS it comes after TMPDIR and TMP.

name: TERM
what: Holds the terminal type, used to recognise terminals such as Ghostty and kitty and their colour support.

name: TERMINAL
what: Sets the terminal program to open on Linux.

name: TERMINAL_EMULATOR
what: The value "JetBrains-JediTerm" marks the terminal as JetBrains.

name: TERMINATOR_UUID
what: Its presence marks the terminal as Terminator.

name: TERMUX_VERSION
what: Its presence marks Termux, where the temporary directory is under PREFIX.

name: TERM_PROGRAM
what: Holds the terminal program name, used for terminal detection.

name: TERM_PROGRAM_VERSION
what: Holds the terminal program version, recorded in terminal diagnostics.

name: TEST_ENABLE_SESSION_PERSISTENCE
what: Keeps session persistence on in a test build. This build always reports production and ignores it.
inert: It is read only when the build type is test. This build's build-type function always returns production.

name: TEST_GRACEFUL_FS_GLOBAL_PATCH
what: Makes the bundled graceful-fs library patch the global fs module.

name: TILIX_ID
what: Its presence marks the terminal as Tilix.

name: TMP
what: On Windows the client reads it after TEMP as the folder for scratch git index files when CLAUDE_CODE_TMPDIR is unset. Outside Windows and macOS it comes after TMPDIR and before TEMP.

name: TMPDIR
what: Names the temporary directory.

name: TMUX
what: Its presence marks a tmux session.

name: TMUX_PANE
what: Names the current tmux pane, used to locate the session's window.

name: TRACEPARENT
what: Gives the W3C trace context parent, used as the parent span in SDK sessions. The client also sets it for child processes.

name: TRACESTATE
what: Sets the W3C trace state accompanying TRACEPARENT.

name: TYPESPEC_RUNTIME_LOG_LEVEL
what: Sets the log level of the bundled TypeSpec runtime logger.

name: ULTRAPLAN_PROMPT_FILE
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: USER
what: Holds the user name. The client builds names from it, such as the browser bridge's socket name.

name: USERNAME
what: Names the Windows user, also used as a fallback user name. The names "ContainerAdministrator" and "ContainerUser" turn off the client's registry sweep.

name: USERPROFILE
what: Names the Windows user profile folder.

name: USE_API_CONTEXT_MANAGEMENT
what: The client reads it where it decides whether to add a context-management beta. That read is joined to a constant false and never adds the beta.
inert: Its only read is joined to a constant false. The beta it would add never follows from it.

name: USE_BUILTIN_RIPGREP
what: A falsy value uses the system ripgrep instead of the bundled one.

name: USE_LOCAL_OAUTH
what: Uses the local OAuth development servers.

name: USE_STAGING_OAUTH
what: Uses the staging OAuth servers.

name: UV_THREADPOOL_SIZE
what: Sets the libuv thread pool size, reported in diagnostics.

name: VCR_RECORD
inert: The client's environment registry declares this variable. No code in this build reads it.

name: VERCEL
what: When truthy, marks the deployment environment as Vercel.

what: Sets the Vertex AI region for Claude Sonnet 4.5 models, used instead of CLOUD_ML_REGION.

what: Sets the Vertex AI region for Claude Opus 4.6 models, used instead of CLOUD_ML_REGION.

what: Sets the Vertex AI region for Claude Sonnet 4.6 models, used instead of CLOUD_ML_REGION.

what: Sets the Vertex AI region for Claude Opus 4.7 models, used instead of CLOUD_ML_REGION.

what: Sets the Vertex AI region for Claude Opus 4.8 models, used instead of CLOUD_ML_REGION.

what: Sets the Vertex AI region for Claude Opus 5.5 models, used instead of CLOUD_ML_REGION.

name: VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_5_5_SONNET
what: Sets the Vertex AI region for Claude Sonnet 5.5 models, used instead of CLOUD_ML_REGION.

what: Sets the Vertex AI region for Claude Opus 5 models, used instead of CLOUD_ML_REGION.

name: VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_5_SONNET
what: Sets the Vertex AI region for Claude Sonnet 5 models, used instead of CLOUD_ML_REGION.

name: VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_FABLE_5
what: Sets the Vertex AI region for Claude Fable 5 models, used instead of CLOUD_ML_REGION.

what: Sets the Vertex AI region for Claude Fable 5.1 models, used instead of CLOUD_ML_REGION.

name: VERTEX_REGION_CLAUDE_HAIKU_4_5
what: Sets the Vertex AI region for Claude Haiku 4.5 models, used instead of CLOUD_ML_REGION.

name: VISUAL
what: Sets the preferred editor.

name: VITALS_EMITTER_BIN
what: Sets the absolute path of the guest vitals emitter binary.

name: VOICE_STREAM_BASE_URL
what: Sets the base URL of the voice streaming service.

name: VSCODE_GIT_ASKPASS_MAIN
what: Holds VS Code's git askpass path, used to recognise Cursor and other VS Code forks.

name: VTE_VERSION
what: Holds the VTE version, used for terminal detection and capability checks.

name: VisualStudioVersion
what: Its presence marks the terminal as Visual Studio's.

name: WAYLAND_DISPLAY
what: Names the Wayland display. The client uses it to detect whether a graphical session is available.

name: WEBSITE_SITE_NAME
what: Its presence marks the deployment environment as Azure App Service.

name: WEBSITE_SKU
what: Its presence marks the deployment environment as Azure App Service.

name: WINDIR
what: Names the Windows folder, used to recognise Explorer and system apps.

name: WSL_DISTRO_NAME
what: Names the WSL distribution and marks the platform as WSL.

name: WSL_INTEROP
what: Its presence marks the platform as WSL.

name: WT_SESSION
what: Its presence marks the terminal as Windows Terminal.

name: XDG_CACHE_HOME
what: Names the XDG cache directory.

name: XDG_CONFIG_HOME
what: Names the XDG configuration directory.

name: XDG_DATA_HOME
what: Names the XDG data directory.

name: XDG_RUNTIME_DIR
what: Names the XDG runtime directory, used for IPC sockets.

name: XDG_STATE_HOME
what: Names the XDG state directory.

name: XTERM_VERSION
what: Its presence marks the terminal as xterm.

name: ZDOTDIR
what: Sets the zsh configuration directory, used when locating shell startup files.

name: ZED_TERM
what: Its presence marks the terminal as Zed's.

name: ZELLIJ
what: Its presence marks a Zellij session.

name: _CLAUDE_CODE_ASSUME_FIRST_PARTY_BASE_URL
what: Treats ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL as a first-party Anthropic host.

name: _X_AMZN_TRACE_ID
what: Holds the AWS X-Ray trace id the bundled AWS SDK forwards.

name: __CFBundleIdentifier
what: Gives the macOS app bundle identifier. The value "com.conductor.app" marks the Conductor app.

name: grpc_proxy
what: Sets the proxy for the bundled gRPC library.

name: no_grpc_proxy
what: Sets the hosts that bypass the proxy in the bundled gRPC library.
